description: Initialization only: For each remaining task, trial its insertion positions in the current prefix and complete the order with remaining tasks in ascending ID order. Fix the task whose best and second-best trial scores have the largest difference, breaking ties by best score then task ID. Return the best full-order trial seen, including a partial last step, at the evaluation limit. Reassignment is not implemented.
Purpose: Prefer tasks whose best and second-best tested positions differ most in score.
